title: Council housing support notice
text: Notice regarding eligibility for the Household Support Scheme. Pursuant to the provisions of the Housing Assistance Regulations, individuals who reside within the borough and whose aggregate household income does not exceed the prescribed threshold are required to submit an application, accompanied by sufficient documentary evidence of income and residence, prior to the commencement of the assessment period on 1 March 2027. In the event that an application is received subsequent to the aforementioned date, the Council shall endeavour to process it; however, remuneration of arrears cannot be guaranteed. Beneficiaries are required to inform the Council forthwith of any change in circumstances, which may affect their entitlement, and failure to do so may result in the termination of assistance and recovery of overpayments in accordance with the Regulations. Applicants requiring assistance in completing the form may obtain help at the Civic Centre (Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm) or by telephoning 0300 123 4567.
